evidence_summary: CACNB2 is the cardiac-relevant L-type calcium-channel beta subunit and UniProt describes CACNA1C interaction with beta subunits; CACNB2 function includes membrane targeting and current modulation.
support_sources: UniProt Q13936; UniProt Q08289; Reactome L-type calcium channel events; prior local AF3 pilot planning
caveat: Full-length alpha/beta channel job lacks membrane and state context.

evidence_summary: Calmodulin mediates calcium-dependent inactivation of CACNA1C and CACNA1C has annotated calmodulin-binding regions including the IQ region. CALM1 sequence is used as a protein proxy for CALM1/2/3.
support_sources: UniProt Q13936 regions 47-68 and 1665-1685; UniProt P0DP23/P0DP24; PubMed 26969752; PubMed 31454269
caveat: CA4 approximates calcium-loaded calmodulin; it is not a measured calcium state.

caveat: Large full-length complex may mix multiple cytosolic interfaces and needs AF3 output QC before feature use.
